items.title: Russia: Trump's Ukraine ceasefire proposal is 'good idea'
items.description: The Kremlin has hailed an "energy ceasefire" proposed by US President Trump, but has criticized a French initiative to share its nuclear deterrent. Meanwhile, hostilities have continued on the ground and in the air.

items.title: Spanish scientists find first evidence of Diplodocus dinosaur in Europe
items.description: Paleontologists in Spain say they have found the first evidence of the long-necked Diplodocus genus of dinosaur outside of North America. They found bones at the rich La Tejeria fossil site in Teruel in eastern Spain.

items.title: Ovechkin still backing Putin party in parliamentary vote
items.description: Ice hockey legend Alexander Ovechkin has lent Vladimir Putin's party a helping hand in its parliamentary election campaign. That's in keeping with a pattern of support by an athlete who claims not to be political.
